messages:
Marta L: Quick thought — backlog is creeping up. Can we pilot pairing people for triage coverage next week and add a 15m 'quick drop' slot mid-day for urgent fixes? :calendar:
Devon: +1 to pairing. What do you mean by 'quick drop' — like a timed window where folks can triage and ship tiny fixes? :thinking_face:
Marta L: Exactly. 15 mins, not a meeting — just a focused window where the on-duty pair handles highest-priority tiny fixes and clears quick tickets. Keeps the main triage call shorter.
Priya: Sounds useful. Time-of-day recs? We have folks across US/EU.
Ariel: If we put it at 14:00 UTC that hits early US and late EU. Might exclude APAC but we already have coverage gaps there.
oncall-bot: Reminder: current triage rota = @Marta L (Mon/Wed), @Devon (Tue/Thu), @Priya (Fri). Use /swap-rotation to request changes.
Devon: If pairing, maybe do overlapping pairs for one week (Mon/Tue pair A, Wed/Thu pair B) so handoff is smooth.
Marta L: Proposal: pair (Marta + Devon) Mon/Tue, (Priya + Ariel) Wed/Thu, Fri solo owner. Add 15m drop at 14:00 UTC daily.
Priya: I'm fine with that pairing for next week. Can we add a short agenda for the 15m drop? e.g. 1) triage highest sev2/3 2) quick PRs <10 LOC 3) assign follow-ups.
Ariel: Agree. Also can we add a lightweight signal in tickets like label "quick-drop" so folks can filter?
Marta L: Good call — I'll add label and update triage playbook. Will ping engineering-docs.
Devon: One concern: would this increase interruptions for infra team? maybe exclude infra-only alerts or use a tiny checklist.
Priya: We can scope to product-facing bug queue only for the pilot. That should limit noise.
Ariel: I'll update the rota and create a shared calendar event for next week with pairing info + 15m drop slot.
oncall-bot: Rotation updated: next-week pairs posted in #eng-rotations.
Marta L: Perfect. If no objections I'll send a short TL;DR in #eng and update the playbook tonight. :thumbsup:
Devon: No objections from me. Thanks all.
Priya: Thanks — excited to try it.
Ariel: Done — calendar invites sent.
Marta L: Closing loop — pilot starts Monday. We'll review after one week in this thread.
